notes.clock_ids: The toolchain numbers CLOCK_MONOTONIC as 4 while the kernel accepts 0..=3, so std::time::Instant panics with EINVAL. The workload times itself through the raw ClockGetTime syscall instead.
notes.tcp_loopback: socket bind returns EPROTONOSUPPORT (109) on 127.0.0.1, so loopback throughput cannot be measured on this build. Recorded as unavailable rather than dropped; it is one of the v1 gaps the v2 plan has to close.
notes.context_switch: Measured as a Mutex/Condvar ping-pong between two threads; one iteration is two switches (wake the peer, block again).
notes.dsc_historical: P0-08 removed the direct-call syscall switch. The dsc numbers were measured before that change and are kept for the record; they cannot be reproduced on this tree.
